bottle.py structure: 4576 total lines. Key vulnerability-prone functions located: static_file() at line 2735 (file serving - path traversal risk CWE-22), add_header() at line 1720 (header manipulation - CRLF injection risk CWE-93), set_cookie() at line 1764 (cookie setting - CRLF injection risk CWE-93), BaseResponse class at line 1588

static_file() function (lines 2735-2834): Path traversal protection exists via os.path.abspath and startswith check (lines 2773, 2777). VULNERABILITY CONFIRMED: The download parameter handling at lines 2803-2804 only removes quotes but does NOT filter CRLF characters, making Content-Disposition header vulnerable to CWE-93 (CRLF Injection) when user-controlled filename is passed.

add_header() method (line 1720-1722): Calls _hval(value) helper before storing header value. VULNERABILITY CONFIRMED: _hval() only converts to unicode without CRLF validation, making add_header() vulnerable to CWE-93 (CRLF Injection) when user-controlled input contains \r or \n characters.

set_cookie() method (lines 1764-1843): VULNERABILITY CONFIRMED: Cookie name and value are stored at line 1828 (self._cookies[name] = value) without CRLF validation. Later at line 1746, _hval(c.OutputString()) is called but this occurs after SimpleCookie processing. User-controlled cookie names/values containing \r\n can inject headers, causing CWE-93 (CRLF Injection).

_hval() helper function (lines 1565-1567): Only converts value to unicode via touni(value) and returns it directly. Does NOT validate or strip CRLF characters (\r\n), making add_header() and set_cookie() vulnerable to CWE-93 (CRLF Injection) when user-controlled input is passed to these functions.
_hkey() helper function (lines 1560-1562): Converts header key to unicode and formats it (title case, replaces underscores with hyphens). No CRLF validation present.

Three CWE-93 vulnerabilities identified: (1) _hval() lacks CRLF validation affecting add_header(), (2) set_cookie() stores unvalidated names/values, (3) static_file() download parameter allows CRLF in Content-Disposition header. Fix must validate/reject CRLF characters in these functions and raise appropriate error type (ValueError for invalid input per requirement #5).
